entities.name: José De León
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Eugenio De León Domenech is a Puerto Rican professional baseball pitcher for the Caliente de Durango of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Tampa Bay Rays, Cincinnati Reds, Minnesota Twins, and Boston Red Sox.
